records.text: Candace Owens said Robert Bohls began his policing career at the Provo Police Department in the early 2000s before joining the military and the FBI.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Of all places, he began at the Provo Police Department back in the early 2000s. Check out this article from 2004, before he joined the FBI. He was at the Provo Police Department.

verification.notes: A 2023 official summit biography states Bohls worked as a Provo Police Department officer and USAF reservist before beginning his FBI career in 2007. It confirms the general pre-FBI career path, but not the precise early-2000s date or the claimed sequence of police, then military, then FBI.

sources.title: 2023 District of Columbia Interoperability Summit After Action Report
